name: To-do list
request:
a list of to-dos
mark a to-do done

checks.given: The app is open and the list has no to-dos.
steps: Type "Buy oats" as a new to-do.

checks.given: The list has the to-dos "Buy oats" and "Shoe the horse", added in that order.
checks.expect: Both to-dos still show, "Buy oats" above "Shoe the horse".

steps: Add a new to-do with nothing typed.
checks.expect: No empty to-do is added to the list.

checks.given: The list has the to-do "Buy oats", not done.
checks.expect: "Buy oats" shows as done, such as ticked or struck through, and is still in the list.

checks.given: The list has the to-do "Buy oats", marked done.
